subject: Kickoff: Success cadence workbook & week0 playbook
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Kai Mendoza <kai@clarahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: Success cadence workbook & week0 playbook

Hi Kai —

Thanks again for a great discovery last week. Per our conversation, I pulled together a compact "Success cadence" workbook that outlines a 30-day evaluation path plus a focused week-0 playbook to accelerate technical validation. The intent is to give Clara Health a single document to align stakeholders, milestones, and success criteria.

Quick highlights:
- Week 0: access, sample data ingestion, baseline perf checks (owners + timeboxes)
- 2-week tech run: integration tests, latency/cost targets, failure-mode checks
- Acceptance gates: example queries + expected metrics and sample prompts
- Decision checkpoints: 14d/30d review with clear go/no-go criteria

Links/attachments:
- success_cadence_workbook_v1.gdoc (link below) — editable, comments open to your team
- week0_playbook.pdf — printable one-pager for engineers

GDoc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2B3cSuccessCadenceWorkbook

Ask: Can you confirm the primary Clara contact for infra access and a preferred 30–60 minute slot this week for a joint kickoff? If procurement needs a copy of the playbook for SOW prep, I can share a PDF to them directly.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on the run.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: success_cadence_workbook_v1.gdoc (Google Doc), week0_playbook.pdf (PDF)

From: Kai Mendoza <kai@clarahealth.com>

Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Success cadence workbook & week0 playbook

Vanessa —

Appreciate this. Quick questions from our side after a skim:
1) For the "sample data ingestion" step, do you need full PHI datasets or can we provide redacted samples? Our infra/security team will want to scope access.
2) For acceptance gates, will you own the test harness or is that on Clara to run?
3) Proposed kickoff: Thu 12/3 between 10–11am PT — does that work?

CC'd procurement so they have the playbook if they want it for SOW drafting. For infra access, loop in Ben (infra@clarahealth.com) — I'll introduce him if the schedule works.

—Kai
Director, Platform Engineering
Clara Health

Hi Kai — thanks for the thoughtful questions. Short answers:

1) Redacted samples are fine for the initial week-0 validation; full PHI access is only required if you want end-to-end throughput/latency on production-like data. We can design the week-0 to start redacted and swap in more sensitive data later under the agreed access controls.

2) Redwood will provide the test harness and a set of baseline scripts (we'll push to a shared repo). Clara should run them in your environment so we can validate network/egress and permissions. We'll coordinate owner-level steps in the workbook.

3) Thu 12/3 10am PT works for us. Suggested agenda (30–45m):
- Introductions (5m)
- Week-0 checklist review & owners (10m)
- Access plan & timeline (10m)
- Acceptance gates & sample queries (10m)
- Next steps + scheduling (5m)

Vanessa: I can bring the baseline scripts and a short demo of the harness. Jasmine — can you upload the harness README to the GDoc under the "Tech Steps" section?

Kai — I'll send a calendar invite after you confirm the attendee list.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
